# s448 — Tests: cache not-a-repo git answers and drop per-call git warnings in the suite

Cut the suite's git subprocess time with test-side changes only: remember not-a-repo answers for fixtures that are not git repos, turn the code-location warning off for every test except the ones that test it, and stop in-memory TUI tests from asking git on each refresh. Lands with or after s447.

**Findings:** The discover run (python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests) takes about 9.5 min; about 84% is git subprocesses (109.5 s of 130 s in 5 modules, failed probes 76.7 s). vcs.is_repo and _current_worktree cache only yes answers and git_common_dir caches nothing (src/slicer/vcs.py:83-135, :399, :511); about 5 of 6 fixtures are not git repos. Change, in tests/support.py and test setup only unless a spec step finds production code must change: (b1) cache not-a-repo answers for non-git fixtures; (b2) set SLICER_NO_CODE_WARNING=1 for the suite except the code-location tests (cli.py:138 costs 2 git calls per CLI call); (b3) in-memory TUI tests do not ask git on each refresh. Acceptance: (1) the unittest discover test count is unchanged and none is removed or skipped; (2) the code-location tests still run with the warning on; (3) wall time of python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests drops by at least 3 minutes, quoted before and after on the same machine; (4) the git call budget tests still pass; (5) slicer check is clean. Source: ork .scratch/v11/test-trim-proposal.md b1-b3. Land with or after s447. · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:** changing the production probe memo in `src/slicer/vcs.py` (it keeps caching only yes answers, so a `git init` is seen at once); removing or skipping any test; the fsync cost (s447). If a step finds production code must change, stop and ask the owner.

## Why

The discover run takes about 9.5 min; about 84% is git subprocesses (109.5 s of 130 s in 5 modules, failed probes 76.7 s). Source: ork `.scratch/v11/test-trim-proposal.md` b1-b3 (not read during speccing; outside this workspace).

What the code shows (read 2026-11-06):

- `vcs.is_repo` (`src/slicer/vcs.py:123-134`) and `_current_worktree` (`:399-415`) memoise only positive answers in `_IS_REPO` and `_WORKTREE` (`:98-99`); `git_common_dir` (`:511-528`) memoises nothing. `vcs.clear_cache` (`:102-105`) is called by every `TempRepo.__init__` and `TempRepo.close` (`tests/support.py:185-275`).
- `cli._warn_code_mismatch` (`src/slicer/cli.py:138-153`) runs on every in-process `main` call unless `SLICER_NO_CODE_WARNING` is set; `vcs.foreign_worktree` (`src/slicer/vcs.py:553-590`) calls `git_common_dir` twice. The tests that need the warning on are `tests/test_code_location.py` (`ForeignWorktreeTests`, `CodeMismatchWarningTests`).
- `tui.View.refresh` (`src/slicer/tui.py:908-926`) calls `vcs.clear_cache()` and `store.sibling_work`, which lists worktrees through git, on every refresh. Several tests in `tests/test_tui.py` already patch `store.sibling_work` (for example `:689`, `:871`).
- Tests that pin probe behaviour and must keep passing: `tests/test_git_calls.py` (`test_Check_InRepoWithSibling_GitCallsBounded`, `test_Note_InRepo_IsRepoProbedOnce`, `test_IsRepo_NotARepoThenGitInit_IsSeenAtOnce`, `test_IsRepo_AfterClearCache_AsksGitAgain`, `test_TuiRefresh_WarmMemo_AsksGitForTheWorktreeAgain`). `test_IsRepo_NotARepoThenGitInit_IsSeenAtOnce` runs `repo._git("init")` after a no answer, so a test-side negative memo must be forgotten when a fixture runs `git init`.

- `tests/support.py` (b1: a test-side negative memo around `vcs.is_repo`, `vcs._current_worktree` and `vcs.git_common_dir`, cleared with `vcs.clear_cache` and by `TempRepo._git("init", ...)`; b2: set `SLICER_NO_CODE_WARNING=1` in `os.environ` at import).

## Failing tests

In `tests/test_support.py` (class `NotARepoMemoTests`):

- `test_Support_NotARepoFixture_IsRepoAskedOnce`: in a `TempRepo()` under `support.isolated_discovery`, two calls of each of `vcs.is_repo`, `vcs._current_worktree` and `vcs.git_common_dir` on `repo.root` inside `support.count_git_calls()` start one `rev-parse` (subTests); a call after `vcs.clear_cache()` asks again. Fails first: two.
- `test_Support_NotARepoMemo_ForgottenAfterGitInit`: after a no answer from each probe, `repo._git("init", "-q")` makes each true at once. Guard for the memo's reset; also keeps `test_IsRepo_NotARepoThenGitInit_IsSeenAtOnce` green.
- `test_Support_CodeWarning_OffForTheSuite`: `os.environ.get("SLICER_NO_CODE_WARNING") == "1"` outside `tests/test_code_location.py`. Fails first: unset.

In `tests/test_code_location.py`:

- `test_Main_Mismatch_WarnsOnStderrAndLeavesStdoutClean` and the other warning tests still pass with the suite-wide variable set, because `CodeMismatchWarningTests.setUp` removes it. Red if it does not.

In `tests/test_tui.py` (class `TuiSortTests`):

- `test_TuiView_InMemoryRefresh_StartsNoGitProcess`: `View.initial(state)` then `view.refresh(state)` on an in-memory state rooted at a non-git fixture inside `support.count_git_calls()` records no call. Fails first: the refresh probes git (`rev-parse --show-toplevel`).
